title: Configure ICP payment address on the registration/login page

requirements.summary: Add an admin configuration panel on the PaymentGate screen that allows the canister owner to view and update the ICP payment wallet address, with appropriate access controls and validation
acceptanceCriteria: The admin configuration UI is only visible to the canister owner when authenticated.
The current ICP payment address is pre-filled in the input field on load.
Saving a new address calls the backend `setIcpAddress` function and shows a success/error toast notification.
The PaymentGate screen immediately reflects the updated address after a successful save.
Non-owner users do not see the configuration UI on the PaymentGate screen.

file_operations.description: Add an admin-only configuration section to the PaymentGate component that displays when the authenticated user is an admin (using isCallerAdmin hook). The section should include a collapsible or inline panel with an input field pre-filled with the current ICP address from useIcpAddress hook, a save button that calls the setIcpAddress mutation, and success/error toast notifications using the shadcn-ui toast component. Position this admin UI visually distinct from the public payment display, using appropriate styling to indicate it's an administrative control. Ensure the component refetches the ICP address after a successful save to reflect the updated value immediately.

Add a new React Query mutation hook `useSetIcpAddress` that calls the backend actor's `setIcpAddress(address: string)` method. Include error handling for authorization failures (admin-only restriction) and network errors. On successful mutation, invalidate the ICP address query cache to trigger a refetch. Return the mutation state including loading, error, and success states for UI feedback. Also add a query hook `useIsCallerAdmin` that calls `isCallerAdmin()` on the backend actor to check if the current user is an admin, with appropriate caching strategy.
